rubric.statement: DSPy defines the unsafe serialized LM settings as exactly `api_base`, `base_url`, and `model_list`.
`Predict.load_state()` defaults `allow_unsafe_lm_state` to `False` and sanitizes `state["lm"]` before reconstructing `self.lm`, so normal reloads do not directly trust serialized LM config.
On the default path, serialized endpoint override keys (`api_base` or `base_url`) are dropped from the loaded LM kwargs, and loading emits a warning naming the ignored key.
`model_list` is treated the same way as the endpoint override keys: by default it is omitted from the loaded LM kwargs and triggers a warning.
Passing `allow_unsafe_lm_state=True` preserves the serialized unsafe LM keys instead of stripping them, and this opt-in is intended only for trusted files.
